Definition: from G1537 and G1453; to rouse fully, i.e. (figuratively) to resuscitate (from death), release (from infliction):--raise up.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, exegeírō is the word for raise up. In Romans 9:17, the text says "Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, exegeírō, does its job quietly — raise up — and I leave it at that.
